gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4) prints five columns: General 195,424,389, Street Construction 43,631,062, West Haymarket JPA 32,952,447, Federal Grants 62,754,527 and 'Other Governmental Funds' 104,631,924 = Total revenues 439,394,349. detail[0..59] are the four major columns from p4 and tie exactly (334,762,425). The Other Governmental Funds column itself is not in detail[]: this trim has no nonmajor combining statements (unlike FY2023), so the extraction used the 13 nonmajor budget-and-actual schedules instead (pp19-31: Cable Access Television, Lincoln City Libraries, Lincoln/Lancaster County Health, Social Security, StarTran, Keno, Building & Safety, Library Special Trust, Lincoln Bike Share, Tax Allocation Projects, Bond Interest & Redemption, Tax Supported Bonds, Community Health Permanent Endowment; detail[60..166]). Those schedules are on the budget basis and cover only some of the nonmajor funds (no capital projects funds etc.): their revenue lines sum to 42,458,394 (193,301 + 10,439,937 + 8,133,432 + 14,646 + 7,458,169 + 7,359,580 + 8,892,641 + 107,819 + 207,655 + 3,739,391 + 3,984,506 + 2,324,054 - 10,396,737), so 334,762,425 + 42,458,394 = 377,220,819 = schedule total and the gap 62,173,530 = 104,631,924 - 42,458,394. The per-fund GAAP amounts of the other nonmajor funds are on combining pages that are not in this trim, so the only exact printed source is the p4 Other Governmental Funds column; keeping the budget-schedule lines next to it would count the same nonmajor money twice. Fix: remove the 43 nonmajor budget-schedule revenue lines and add the 15 non-zero revenue rows of the p4 Other Governmental Funds column (Property 27,567,122; Wheel 19,529,692; Sales and Use 16,916,479; Turnback 677,204; Sundry and In Lieu 9,164; Occupation 1,654,430; Special Assessment 1,526,874; Intergovernmental 17,749,921; Permits and Fees 16,848,659; Reimbursement for Services 884,260; Investment Loss (11,147,385); Donations 2,603,624; Keno Proceeds 7,082,106; Private Sector Share of Projects 2,358,866; Miscellaneous 370,908 = 104,631,924). Check: 377,220,819 + 104,631,924 - 42,458,394 = 439,394,349 = statement total. (A re-trim adding the nonmajor combining statements would allow per-fund lines instead, as in FY2023.)

gaps.explanation: Same statement (p4): General 157,850,532 + Street Construction 66,151,459 + West Haymarket JPA 27,618,257 + Federal Grants 68,032,860 (= 319,653,108, in detail and tying) + Other Governmental Funds 109,256,238 = Total expenditures 428,909,346. The nonmajor budget-basis schedules in detail (pp19-31) carry 76,078,387 of expenditure lines (168,222 + 10,104,448 + 15,425,884 + 14,540,926 + 4,041,018 + 8,295,720 + 91,715 + 315,193 + 2,681,461 + 8,868,467 + 9,375,020 + 2,170,313; Cable and Libraries lines exceed their printed totals by 1 each, report rounding), so 319,653,108 + 76,078,387 = 395,731,495 = schedule total and the gap 33,177,851 = 109,256,238 - 76,078,387. Fix (same reasoning as revenue): remove the 48 nonmajor budget-schedule expenditure lines and add the 8 non-zero expenditure rows of the p4 Other Governmental Funds column (Current: General Government 14,809,372; Public Safety 8,274,053; Streets and Highways 103; Culture and Recreation 11,626,168; Health and Welfare 17,029,046; Mass Transit 18,114,452; Debt Service 22,383,319; Capital Outlay 17,019,725 = 109,256,238). Check: 395,731,495 + 109,256,238 - 76,078,387 = 428,909,346 = statement total.

gaps.explanation: Same statement (p4): Transfers In General 24,037,885 + Street Construction 28,916,749 + Federal Grants 1,299,540 (= 54,254,174, in detail) + Other Governmental Funds 38,614,608 = 92,868,782. The nonmajor budget schedules carry 29,091,654 of transfers in (Libraries 8,700, Health 7,950,485, StarTran 8,629,003, Building & Safety 1,401,938, Tax Allocation Projects 168,360, Bond Interest & Redemption 4,746,988, Tax Supported Bonds 6,186,180), so 54,254,174 + 29,091,654 = 83,345,828 = schedule total; gap 9,522,954 = 38,614,608 - 29,091,654. Fix: remove those 7 lines and add the p4 Other Governmental Funds Transfers In 38,614,608. Check: 83,345,828 + 38,614,608 - 29,091,654 = 92,868,782. Note outside the gap rows: detail[104] StarTran 'Sale of assets' 13,770 (budget basis, other financing) is the one nonmajor budget-schedule line not listed for removal here; the p4 Other Governmental Funds column also prints Leases Issued 42,380 and Sale of Capital Assets 395,360 (other financing, not part of any gap row). If the nonmajor replacement is applied, detail[104] should be replaced by those two p4 lines for consistency; they do not affect the transfer totals.
